title: The test oracle: how you know the result is correct

videos.script: A test produces a result. Thirty-six reais. On its own, that says nothing. Something has to say what it should have been. That something is the oracle. {{oracle}} Sometimes it is written down. The rule, an agreed example. Sometimes it is a person, like Célia at the counter. Sometimes it is free: a crash is wrong in any program. {{kinds}} And sometimes nobody knows the right answer, but everybody knows a relation. A morning ticket must not cost more than an afternoon one. Lia checked that relation across thirty-six combinations, and it found the nine thirty defect without knowing what nine thirty should cost. {{relations}} Oracles can be wrong too. A rule, an example, a poster at the door. When two of them disagree, ask the person who decides. And in every defect report, say according to what. {{end}}
